svg.text: One real spin: the Normal program on night 3, every strip, every time unit (seed 45)
Each row is one strip (one candidate trade): green = on, grey = off, gold = on the hump, mid-flip
Close up: the strip for AP>W (7 Karma), its real position. It rattles in its dip and hops while the drum is hot.
time (units): Normal cools for 1000, then the drum stops for 20
What the i9 reads through the Hall sensors, and what it keeps
the i9 latches the best set at t = 294
Grey dots: the score of whatever the strips show (read when every strip sits in a dip; clashes score below zero). Gold: the best the i9 has seen so far.
Night 3, 48 spins: the latch got a best set 26 times (median t = 161); the strips came to rest on one 1 times. 2 sets tie for the best tonight.
